audit_scope: Mythic Bastionland L1 content and POI relationships; read-only product audit

operational_sources.note: Shared operational branch can advance concurrently; product findings are pinned to exact main SHA.

status_semantics.implemented: Runtime supports the stated bounded capability on inspected product SHA.
status_semantics.partial: Some source semantics or derived acceptance behavior exists; named remainder is missing.
status_semantics.not_implemented: A specific required procedure/link is absent, beyond generic text editing.
status_semantics.owner_exception: Difference from researched source is an explicit existing owner product decision, not automatically a product defect.

findings.subject: Six landmark types with3–4 of each
implemented: Six kinds: dwelling, sanctuary, monument, hazard, curse, ruins.
Generator allocates3 or4 separately for each kind inside one144-hex kingdom area; central/noncentral both count.
Each kind has a distinct built-in emoji/SVG icon; letters are not necessary under source icon alternative.
Existing kingdom handler validates quotas through real generation, save validation, undo/redo, regeneration and second kingdom.
gaps: No dedicated UI for a prescribed six-number count vector; counts are generator RNG decisions. Manual POI editing can change a map, but does not assert procedure completeness.

No per-instance letter/custom icon choice or research-profile completeness validator demonstrated. Fixed icons satisfy the bounded source marking alternative, while these extra acceptance operations are product interpretations.
findings.owner_contract: docs/mythic-bastionland.md:53–68 explicitly specifies random3–4 counts and permits manual departures without automatic rebalancing.

probes.method: 10 synthetic dry regions,100slots,4 settled and6wild; controlled production allocator RNG after100slot draws+3holding draws.

findings.assessment: Count/type/icon/save core already exists; do not propose building it from scratch.

findings.subject: Sanctum→Seer by ordered d6/d12
implemented: New sanctuary automatically receives separate mb.sanctum description and mb.seer identity tags.
Seer uses ordered d6 first,d12second; product resolver index=(d6-1)*12+d12-1.
Known source1/1→The Rotted Seer and1/2→The Swollen Seer produce exact expected EN identities.
Seer tag keeps dice,table identity/version,entryId,text snapshot,owner and counters; can reroll/edit separately and survives JSON import/export and undo/redo.
Invalid input pairs0/1,7/1,1/0,1/13 are rejected by saved-tag validation.
findings.source_boundary: Official Quickstart research has only two fully verified chains and table-only others. Product data uses supplied full Russian book for72Seers; this audit compared catalogs but did not independently re-read72source cards.
findings.assessment: Seer identity is already implemented for verified pairs1/1and1/2,and72-entry production table exists. Treat the direct lookup as equivalent behavior. Remaining source72mapping audit is unverified,not a new feature requirement. Do not propose work solely for Knight provenance.
source_coverage_limitations: The direct flattened d6/d12→Seer lookup is behaviorally equivalent to selecting the Knight and reading that card for checked1/1and1/2 outputs. Missing intermediate runtime Knight/page fields alone is not a missing source rule.
All72Seer names and their order are in production and match operational catalog; this audit did not reread all72source cards,so full72source mapping remains unverified.

Runtime has no special pending_source_card/provenance UI. Those are derived operational acceptance interpretations,not independently established mandatory source functionality; no new product task is justified solely by their absence.
No Seer biography,abilities or stats; current owner scope explicitly covers names and dice.

findings.subject: Ruins hint at a myth inactive in their own Realm
implemented: Ruins have an independently rolled72-row mb.ruin descriptive prompt and optional feature tag.
Descriptions,manual override and generic map notes can be saved, but do not implement inactive-myth eligibility.
gaps: No current local Realm active-myth set or unknown-versus-empty state used by Ruin roll.
No exclusion of locally active myths,no pending_active_set/no_eligible state,no defined eligibility-preserving reroll.
Generic manual hint text is not automatic source-rule implementation.

runtime_probe.note: The Ruin description uses the same catalogue-row pair as the current map Myth. Its persisted entryId is mb.ruin, with no mechanical mb.myth link or active-set eligibility state.

findings.assessment: Partial source support: Ruin prompt exists; locally inactive-myth relation/filter does not. This is an explicitly excluded scope,not a regression in existing owner requirements. Pair collision proves no filtering of catalog rows; because Ruin stores mb.ruin:25 rather than mb.myth:25,do not misdescribe it as an implemented but incorrect myth-link command.

findings.subject: Six Myth Hexes and map labels1–6
implemented: Exactly6Myth POIs generated inside kingdom area,at most1per wild region.
Each new Myth POI receives an independent72-entry mb.myth tag with stable owner/dice/entry snapshot.
Tag state and positions survive save and undo/redo.
gaps: No separate1–6map-label field,permutation/uniqueness validator or renumber UI.
No numerical remoteness guarantee; research itself leaves threshold unknown.
No assertion of six unique catalog myths: independent draws permit repeats; research source does not establish uniqueness requirement.
findings.owner_contract: docs/mythic-bastionland.md:1–4 prioritizes owner06Oct specification; line56 explicitly says six Myths without numbers.
findings.assessment: Source numbering is missing by explicit product decision. Reversing it requires changing that decision, not silently treating current owner contract as a regression.

findings.subject: Production data and operational catalogs
notes: Operational JSON catalogs are source/provenance materials,not runtime by themselves. The corresponding flattened names/prompts are independently present in published main.
All72full reference-material records are also in main; not merely an operational future catalog. Material source pages29–171,omens and roles are reference text.
Production English interface uses RU fallback when missing; this is deliberate and should not be presented as72translated EN records.
Catalog equality and structural selection are not independent verification of the full Russian transcription against original PDF.

findings.subject: Tag saves and reference material
implemented: TagState saves identity/version,owner,ordered actual dice,entry IDs,snapshots,overrides and independent roll counters.
Import validates matching known snapshots and references; unknown dictionary versions are read-only snapshots.
Actual App legacy import does not auto-roll; explicit fill adds missing tags and existing tags are preserved.
Seer reroll preserves sanctuary-description tag. Undo/redo and v9roundtrip preserve tag state.
All72myth-material records select by exact mb.myth snapshot identity; material reading has no map command,RNG use or automatic omen activation.

limits: Finite tests/seeds support only listed cases.
No live-site or primary-PDF re-transcription verification performed in this sub-audit.
Exact required source-version equivalence between supplied Russian full book,official free Quickstart and Realm Sheets is not assumed.
No score,ranking,rule registry,backlog,claims,automation or GitHub writes. Parent owns overall audit publication and automation health.
